scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix web install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix admin install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix api && npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm start --prefix api" "npm start --prefix admin" "npm start --prefix web"
